namespace Aproda.Base;

codeunit 50900 "Translation Test Mgt"
{
    procedure ShowSingleParameterMessage(ItemNo: Code[20])
    begin
        Message(SingleParameterMsg, ItemNo);
    end;

    procedure ShowFourParameterMessage(ItemNo: Code[20]; Description: Text[100]; ResponsibleEmployee: Text[100]; PostingDate: Date)
    begin
        Message(FourParameterMsg, ItemNo, Description, ResponsibleEmployee, PostingDate);
    end;

    procedure GetDefaultResponsibleEmployee(): Text[100]
    begin
        // literal name incl. sharp-S ("ß") for translation/encoding testing
        exit(DefaultResponsibleEmployeeTxt);
    end;

    var
        SingleParameterMsg: Label 'Translation test for item %1.', Comment = '%1 = Item No.';
        FourParameterMsg: Label 'Item %1 (%2), responsible: %3, posting date: %4.', Comment = '%1 = Item No.; %2 = Description; %3 = Responsible Employee; %4 = Posting Date';
        DefaultResponsibleEmployeeTxt: Label 'Hans Maßrichter';
        // must NOT appear in the generated XLIFF
        TechnicalKeyTok: Label 'ItemNo=%1;Qty=%2', Locked = true;
        // XML-significant characters must survive escaping and the round trip
        SpecialCharsQst: Label 'Save & close "%1" <draft>?', Comment = '%1 = Document No.';
        // classic dialog placeholder style
        ProgressMsg: Label 'Processing item    #1##########';
        // no letters at all: nothing to translate, target must equal source
        RatioTok: Label '%1 / %2', Comment = '%1 = Numerator; %2 = Denominator';
        // same domain term in two labels: terminology must stay consistent
        DeliveryNoteCreatedMsg: Label 'The delivery note for %1 was created.', Comment = '%1 = Customer Name';
        DeliveryNotePrintErr: Label 'The delivery note could not be printed.';
        // length-constrained caption
        ShortQuantityTxt: Label 'Qty.', MaxLength = 10;
}
